core: MECP2 regulation of neuronal gene expression
qualifier: methyl-DNA binding and neuronal channel/GABA targets, not corepressor recruitment
name: MECP2 methyl-DNA binding and neuronal signaling gene regulation
rationale: Most members are MECP2 regulation, methyl-DNA binding and target-gene pathways (neuronal ligands, receptors, channels, GABA), with calcium channel and touch-perception terms fitting Rett-type neuronal targets; unlike confusables it lacks the HDAC/NCoR corepressor and behavioural terms.

qualifier: with ROS detoxification, NADPH supply and ferroptosis control
name: NRF2 antioxidant response, NADPH supply and ferroptosis control
rationale: Members cover NFE2L2 regulation and its target programs plus ROS detoxification, redox homeostasis, NADPH/isocitrate metabolism and ferroptosis; confusables lack either the NFE2L2 arm (p53/mTOR, HIF) or the ROS/ferroptosis arm (glutathione transport).

core: Nucleoside and nucleobase plasma membrane transport
qualifier: endogenous substrates such as adenosine and uridine
name: Endogenous nucleoside and nucleobase plasma membrane transport
rationale: All members are transmembrane transport of purine/pyrimidine nucleosides and bases (adenine, adenosine, uridine); confusables add antiviral drug handling, nucleotide catabolism or organic ion/xenobiotic transport.

qualifier: membrane bending, fusion and positioning
name: ER tubular network shaping, membrane fusion and positioning
rationale: Members concern formation, regulation, bending and homotypic fusion of the tubular ER and its localization/tethering; confusables center on ER lipid transfer and phosphoinositide synthesis instead.

core: Y-linked genes in male germline maintenance
qualifier: spermatogonial stem cells, mRNA export and crotonylation regulators
name: Y-linked genes in spermatogonial stem cell maintenance
rationale: The heterogeneous members (spermatogonial division, germline stem cell maintenance, chromosome Y genes, crotonylation, mRNA export, lncRNA transcription) plausibly share Y-chromosome genes and their homologs active in the male germline, a weak link; confusables are sperm chromatin, histone-modifier and maternal-to-zygotic themes.

qualifier: activation, degranulation and granzyme-mediated killing
name: NK cell cytotoxic activation, degranulation and granzyme killing
rationale: Members describe NK (and T) cell cytotoxicity, degranulation, cytokine production, MHC-Ib presentation and granzyme death signaling; confusables emphasize inhibitory KIR/tolerance regulation or general NK/T expression modules.

qualifier: including its inherited defects
name: Cobalamin uptake, transport, metabolism and inherited defects
rationale: Every member concerns vitamin B12: dietary uptake, plasma transport, intracellular processing to cofactors (propionyl-CoA catabolism) and the gene defects causing B12 disorders; confusables are folate/methionine or other B-vitamin metabolism.

qualifier: driving macrophage proliferation
name: CSF1 receptor signaling and macrophage proliferation
rationale: Members are M-CSF/CSF1R signaling (including the interleukin/SHC receptor arms) and its control of macrophage proliferation; confusables are G-CSF/granulocyte, osteoclast, monocyte differentiation or IL-6 signaling.

qualifier: G protein-coupled receptors, prostaglandin D response
name: Prostanoid G protein-coupled receptor signaling
rationale: Members are prostanoid ligand receptors, GPCR expression modules and response to prostaglandin D; confusables cover prostaglandin synthesis (COX/PLA2) or leukotriene receptors.

qualifier: deoxynucleotide catabolism and pyrimidine salvage
name: Deoxynucleotide catabolism and pyrimidine monophosphate salvage
rationale: Members are catabolism of dGMP, dTMP and deoxyribonucleosides plus CMP/dCMP metabolism and UMP salvage; confusables focus on purine deoxynucleoside defects (ADA/PNP) or pyrimidine base catabolism.

qualifier: monocyte, macrophage, dendritic cell and osteoclast differentiation and fusion
name: CSF1-driven monocyte, macrophage and osteoclast differentiation and fusion
rationale: Members span M-CSF signaling and differentiation, proliferation and fusion of monocytes, macrophages, myeloid DCs and osteoclasts; confusables carry interleukin/SHC signaling and bone remodeling terms rather than the differentiation/fusion set.

qualifier: lipogenesis, adipose lipolysis and VLDL remodeling
name: LXR-regulated lipogenesis, triglyceride lipolysis and VLDL remodeling
rationale: Members are NR1H2/NR1H3 (LXR) target programs for lipogenesis and adipose lipolysis plus inhibition of VLDL remodeling; confusables are lipoprotein clearance, lipophagy or PKA/AMPK triglyceride control.

qualifier: MYC-driven Pol I/III transcription, rRNA, snRNA and splicing
name: MYC-driven nuclear RNA synthesis, processing and ribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members cover Pol I/III and snRNA transcription, rRNA/tRNA/snRNA processing and modification, splicing, 3'-end processing and MYC targets; confusables are Pol II initiation/HIV elongation, telomerase, or mRNA export/decay/translation.

qualifier: junction assembly and its regulation, including EMT and endothelium
name: Adherens junction assembly and cadherin adhesion regulation
rationale: Members are adherens junction assembly/organization, calcium-dependent cadherin adhesion and its positive/negative regulation, with EMT and endothelial morphogenesis; confusables emphasize epithelial polarity or specific CDH1/CDH11 handling.

qualifier: dendritic cell maturation and CCR1/CCR7-type migration
name: Chemokine-guided dendritic cell maturation and leukocyte migration
rationale: Members combine chemokine/CCR signaling modules with DC maturation, survival and chemotaxis plus NK/T cell migration and monocyte differentiation; confusables are lymphocyte homing/B cell, CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte or integrin-adhesion themes.

qualifier: microglial differentiation, proliferation and cytotoxicity
name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta clearance
rationale: Members are microglial differentiation, activation, migration and cytotoxicity together with amyloid-beta formation, fibrillization, clearance and tau tangles; confusables lack the microglial cell terms or the amyloid regulation set.

qualifier: TGFBR3 coreceptor control and cancer receptor/SMAD mutants
name: TGF-beta/activin signaling via TGFBR3 and cancer mutants
rationale: Members are TGF-beta superfamily receptor signaling (TGFBR3 regulation, activin, AMH) and cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMADs; confusables are RUNX3/Hippo, MET or SMAD transcriptional downregulation.

qualifier: retinol and retinal, outside the visual cycle and retinoic acid
name: Retinol and retinal metabolism and transport
rationale: Members are retinoid (diterpenoid) metabolism and transport of retinol and retinal; confusables are the visual retinoid cycle and its defects or retinoic acid synthesis/catabolism.

qualifier: handling of nucleoside-analogue antiviral drugs
name: Purine nucleoside and antiviral nucleoside-analogue drug transport
rationale: Members are purine nucleoside/nucleobase transmembrane transport plus abacavir and ribavirin handling; confusables add adenosine/uridine transport or thiopurine and nucleotide catabolism instead.

qualifier: HDAC/NuRD corepressors and cofactor SUMOylation
name: HDAC/NuRD corepressor chromatin regulation and cofactor SUMOylation
rationale: Members are corepressor-linked chromatin events (HDAC deacetylation, NuRD, NCoR/SMRT, CHD6-9, E2F6, arginine methylation) and SUMOylation of cofactors controlling specific genes; confusables center on BAF, HAT and methylation/imprinting complexes.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor signaling and CC-chemokine production
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven myeloid chemotaxis and chemokine production
rationale: Members are formyl peptide receptor responses, neutrophil/granulocyte/macrophage chemotaxis and production of CCL2, CCL3 and CCL5; confusables lack the chemokine-production terms and add neutrophil migration inhibition or degranulation.

qualifier: cohesion, condensation, centromere and cytokinesis with NE reformation
name: Mitotic chromosome cohesion, condensation, segregation and cytokinesis
rationale: Members span sister chromatid cohesion, chromosome condensation, CENP-A deposition, spindle/kinetochore regulation, cytokinesis and nuclear envelope reformation; confusables are centrosome maturation, meiotic recombination, APC/C control or nuclear envelope breakdown.

qualifier: calcium-dependent, regulating GABAergic inhibition
name: Presynaptic calcium control of GABA release and synaptic strength
rationale: Members are presynaptic calcium entry, vesicle exocytosis, GABA secretion and short-term modulation of GABAergic and glutamatergic transmission; confusables are G protein-gated K channel/kainate presynaptic signaling or glutamate secretion.

qualifier: endothelial fate and vessel morphogenesis
name: BMP/Nodal signaling in endothelial fate and vessel morphogenesis
rationale: Members combine extracellular BMP/Nodal ligand sequestration and SMAD signaling regulation with endothelial differentiation and arterial, venous, lymphatic and CNS vessel formation; confusables lack either the vascular or the BMP/Nodal sequestration arm.

qualifier: MYC-driven, with Pol I rRNA transcription
name: MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis and RNA polymerase I transcription
rationale: Members are MYC target programs, Pol I rRNA transcription and its regulation, rRNA cleavage and ribosome assembly; confusables are broader Pol I/III, splicing, translation-initiation or Pol II elongation themes.
